Simulation tasks

Ten sequences. Thirty measurable stages.

From kitchen preparation to precision assembly, each long-horizon task is decomposed into physically grounded stages.

Meal Preparation Cabinet & Pouring Drawer & Plug Nut & Bolt Office Desk Meal Preparation Cabinet & Pouring Drawer & Plug Nut & Bolt Office Desk
Furniture Assembly Pipette Transfer Juice Preparation Package Opening Table Cleaning Furniture Assembly Pipette Transfer Juice Preparation Package Opening Table Cleaning

The same recorded stages, re-rendered across diverse RoboCasa interiors. Presentation scenes only, not new policy evaluations. Original images remain available as fallbacks.
